coverage_explanation: Tests the required LCD text on startup and across repeated active-HIGH press/release transitions, plus the electrically specified button input mode. The host LCD checks observe API text output, not landscape orientation, cursor position, text color/size, or black background clearing; those essential graphical requirements remain unverified. No assertion is made about repeated printing while a button remains held.
assumptions: Explicit wiring overrides bench defaults: pin 2 is externally pulled LOW through 10kΩ and reads HIGH when pressed; no INPUT_PULLUP is used.
LCD wiring is preserved: RST=8, D/C=9, CS=10, MOSI=11, MISO=12, SCK=13.
The malformed opening quotation marks in the behavior description are prose delimiters, not characters to display; the required text is Pressed! and Not pressed!.
No debounce interval or exact response deadline is specified; checks allow 700ms after each stable transition.
Landscape rotation 1 is a permitted landscape orientation for the reference. The test does not require that particular landscape orientation.
No bench-default LED, analog, or button wiring assumptions are needed.
